S01E02-NARRATOR-001.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-001.text: Milo and his friends have a new place to visit.

S01E02-NARRATOR-002.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-002.text: The old sign points to Riverside.

S01E02-MILO-002.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-002.text: But it stops at a fence.

S01E02-MILO-003.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-003.text: Maybe the new fence is the only change.

S01E02-MILO-004.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-004.text: Maybe the old way is still behind it.

S01E02-FINN-002.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-002.text: There is a lookout sign, too.

S01E02-NIA-003.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-003.text: There are stones on both sides.

S01E02-FINN-003.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-003.text: They point to the same line.

S01E02-MILO-006.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-006.text: So the map may show a real old way!

S01E02-UI-005.speaker: UI
S01E02-UI-005.text: Follow the sign to the lookout.

S01E02-NARRATOR-004.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-004.text: The path bends along this side of the river.

S01E02-MILO-007.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-007.text: We can see more from here.

S01E02-FINN-005.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-005.text: And we stayed on the safe path.

S01E02-MILO-008.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-008.text: Wait. There is no bridge here now.

S01E02-FINN-006.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-006.text: A path needs a way across.

S01E02-MILO-010.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-010.text: This is a nice place to stop.

S01E02-NIA-008.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-008.text: The old map shows a line here.

S01E02-NIA-009.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-009.text: We have two things to remember.

S01E02-MILO-011.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-011.text: I thought it was only the fence.

S01E02-UI-008.speaker: UI
S01E02-UI-008.text: Which fact does not fit that idea?

S01E02-NIA-010.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-010.text: Those stones show where the way was.

S01E02-FINN-009.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-009.text: Do they show a bridge here now?

S01E02-MILO-012.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-012.text: Oh. My idea does not fit.

S01E02-MILO-013.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-013.text: The fence is not the only change.

S01E02-NIA-011.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-011.text: The stones show the old way.

S01E02-FINN-010.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-010.text: The gap shows what is here now.

S01E02-MILO-016.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-016.text: I don't know why it changed.

S01E02-MILO-017.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-017.text: I was wrong about only the fence.

S01E02-MILO-019.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-019.text: Maybe we can learn why later.

S01E02-NIA-012.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-012.text: Our notes can show both times.

S01E02-FINN-011.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-011.text: A real old way. A different way now.

S01E02-NIA-014.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-014.text: Let's write it in our Chronicle.

S01E02-NARRATOR-006.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-006.text: But the bridge is not here now.

S01E02-NIA-015.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-015.text: This picture shows the old stones.

S01E02-NIA-016.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-016.text: This picture shows the gap today.

S01E02-MILO-023.speaker: MILO
S01E02-MILO-023.text: I changed my idea because of what we saw.

S01E02-FINN-014.speaker: FINN
S01E02-FINN-014.text: And we found a safe place to look.

S01E02-NIA-017.speaker: NIA
S01E02-NIA-017.text: We still do not know why.

S01E02-NARRATOR-007.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-007.text: The Riverside Overlook is now in the Chronicle.

S01E02-NARRATOR-008.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-008.text: One old mark points toward Market Lane.

S01E02-UI-013.speaker: UI
S01E02-UI-013.text: You can use the public path.

S01E02-UI-014.speaker: UI
S01E02-UI-014.text: Choose a picture you have seen.

S01E02-NARRATOR-009.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-009.text: We found the old path at Riverside.

S01E02-NARRATOR-010.speaker: NARRATOR
S01E02-NARRATOR-010.text: Let's see what we know so far.

parent.preview: Your child follows the Riverside clue, sees an old path and a public lookout, then compares what is there today with Milo's first idea. Let them notice first.
parent.cue: What can we see that doesn't fit Milo's first idea?
parent.reflection: How did Milo change his idea? What is still unknown?
